name: External Payment Modification Rejection 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for the rejection of a modification, as published in an external payment modification rejection code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

UM01.name: Unable To Modify Related Reference
UM01.definition: Related transaction reference cannot be modified.

UM02.name: Unable To Modify Payment Service Level
UM02.definition: Service level element of payment type cannot be modified(former UnableToModifyBankOperationCode).

UM03.name: Unable To Modify Category Purpose
UM03.definition: Category purpose element of payment type cannot be modified (former UnableToModifyInstructionCode).

UM04.name: Unable To Modify Requested Execution Date

UM05.name: Unable To Modify Interbank Settlement Date

UM06.name: Unable To Modify Interbank Settlement Account

UM09.name: Unable To Modify Instructed Reimbursement Agent

UM10.name: Unable To Modify Third Reimbursement Agent

UM11.name: Unable To Modify Payment Clearing Channel
UM11.definition: Clearing Channel element of payment type cannot be modified (former UnableToModifyPaymentScheme)

UM12.name: Unable To Modify Creditor Agent Account
UM12.definition: Creditor agent account cannot be modified (former UnableToModifyAccountOfBeneficiaryInstitution)

UM17.name: Unable To Modify Charge Bearer
UM17.definition: Charge bearer cannot be modified (former UnableToModifyDetailsOfCharges).

UM18.name: Unable To Modify Instruction For Next Agent
UM18.definition: Instruction for next agent cannot be modified (former UnableToModifySenderToReceiver).

UM19.name: Unable To Modify Instruction For Creditor Agent
UM19.definition: Instruction for creditor agent cannot be modified. (former UnableToModifyInstructionForFinalAgent).

UM20.name: Instruction Cancelled Submit New Instruction
UM20.definition: Used to inform of cancellation and request a new payment instruction. This should only be used if an agent does not want to modify a pending payment.

UM21.name: Unable To Modify Submit Cancellation
UM21.definition: Modification is not possible and the cancellation is requested.

UM22.name: Unable To Modify Debtor Agent Account
UM22.definition: Debtor agent account cannot be modified (applicable for direct debits).

UM23.name: Unable To Modify Interbank Settlement Amount
UM23.definition: Interbank settlement amount cannot be modified.

UM24.name: Unable To Modify Instruction For Debtor Agent
UM24.definition: Instruction for debtor agent cannot be modified (applicable for direct debits)

UM25.name: Unable To Modify Requested Collection Date
UM25.definition: Requested collection date cannot be modified (applicable for direct debits)

UM27.name: Unable To Modify Instructed Amount
UM27.definition: Instructed or equivalent amount cannot be modified.

UM28.name: Unable To Modify Priority
UM28.definition: Priority of payment message cannot be modified.
